newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain still studying 2-segment Endesa sale.
newsitem.headline: Spain still studying 2-segment Endesa sale.

text.p: The Spanish government is still studying the sale of electricity firm Endesa in two separate placements instead of three as originally planned, Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Tuesday.
"This would mean that after the summer between 30 and 35 percent of Endesa would be placed on the market and the rest during 1998," Pique told journalists on his way into parliament.
The state still owns 67 percent of the utility.

He added that the recent rise in Endesa's stock was part of the general trend in the bourse, although Endesa outperformed the market reflecting "confidence with respect to Endesa's possibilities within the new electricity framework".
The sector signed a framework deal aimed at liberalising the sector at the end of last year.
At 0940 GMT Endesa shares were down 80 pesetas to 10,670.
